name: Catherine Emilia Perride
source:
A talented young pianist, whom the Marquis has watched with growing interest since her childhood. They begin a rather tenuous but passionate relationship in their adulthood. She is a cheerful young lady with a kind spirit. She is prone to mood swings, naivete and exaggeration. She loves Rosa like a sister, and feels a certain devotion to her as well.

[From [url=http://cupidvn.tumblr.com/story]official site[/url]]
